name: Summarize plots of films, shows, and games
description: Users requested summaries of specific media content, including films, television episodes, video games, and online videos, often citing titles, links, or provided transcripts. The requests varied in scope, ranging from general plot synopses and note-taking to extracting specific arguments or generating scripts based on the summarized material.
